why_this_file: The reverse read — what the traded price must believe — is a DIAGNOSTIC and lives outside the numbers file every builder reads. A quantity solved from a price and then used anywhere in the valuation is the reverse-engineered rate the protocol prohibits outright, arriving through a side door. Nothing in this file is an input to anything.

implied.quantity: the rate at which contracted sales become operating cash
implied.solved_on: this study's own model, holding every driver at its published value and the cost-of-capital schedule fixed, and varying only cash conversion until the model reproduces the traded price
implied.reading: At EGP 15.20 the price is paying for 7.89% of revenue reaching operating cash. The company has published three cash-flow statements and they show 4.3%, 17.9% and 3.9%; the study carries their mean, 8.71%. The market is therefore paying for something inside the company's own observed range and a little below its average — which is a narrower disagreement than the headline gap suggests.
